title: What Optical Bus Interconnects Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Optical bus interconnects replace copper wires between chips with light: silicon-photonic links carrying terabits between processors, memory, and accelerators at a fraction of the energy — the end of the copper bottleneck inside computers. This record is the entry point of the teaching ladder for Optical Bus Interconnects: start here, then move through the research state, the specifications, the public developments, the open challenges, and finally each piece needed to build it.
key_points: Optical Bus Interconnects in one line: Optical bus interconnects replace copper wires between chips with light: silicon-photonic links carrying terabits between processors, memory, and accelerators at a fraction of the energy — the end of the copper bottleneck inside computers.
Why it matters: Copper wires cannot keep up with AI bandwidth demands; light can, at lower energy..
Where it is used: data centers, AI clusters, high-performance computing, chiplet interconnect..
